verdicts.reason: A keeps a clear top-to-bottom story (logo, headline, sub, can, CTA) with a strong one-line headline. But the headline is left-aligned while the logo, can and CTA are centred, the logo and headline sit on the translucent circle, there is a large dead gap between the sub-copy and the can, and the CTA is stranded far from its copy. B groups the headline, sub-copy and CTA well. But it demotes the logo to a tiny badge jammed into the bottom-left corner, mixes left-aligned text with a centred CTA, and leaves the can floating on the decorative circle at the top, so the brand loses its place in the reading order.
